messages:
priya: Quick heads-up — ran cross-model long-context benchmarks (64k vs 16k) across eu-west1 (MI300) and us-central1 (H100). Models: Llama-2-70B, Mistral-8B, Qwen-7B. Qwen in EU repeatedly hit kernel fallbacks and p99 spikes, looks like a kernel selection issue

matt: Ugh, can you paste the run CLI and the kernel trace?

priya: Here are the commands and a trimmed trace:
```bash
# bench command
./bench_runner --model qwen-7b --region eu-west1 --gpu mi300 --ctx 65536 --batch 1 --seq_profile longseq.yaml --quant q4_0
```

Trace excerpt: 
```
kernel_select: preferred=mi300_fast_attention_v2
kernel_select: fallback=mi300_continuous_batching
kernel_select: fallthrough=cpu_hybrid_kernel
latency: p99=1.92s (spike during rollover)
```

priya: Same test on us-central1 (H100) used h100_opt_kernel and did not fall back; p99 ~ 320ms for Qwen at 64k

luca: Likely root cause: Qwen's rope/GQA layout + our kernel heuristics. With very long KV lengths the kernel selector thinks the mi300_fast_attention_v2 will exceed temp buffer and falls back. The fallback path is not optimized for long KV so you see p99 regen.

hana: Quick numbers snapshot (subset):
- Qwen-7B eu/MI300: throughput 9 tok/s, p50 180ms, p95 680ms, p99 1.92s
- Qwen-7B us/H100: throughput 26 tok/s, p50 110ms, p95 280ms, p99 320ms
- Llama-2-70B eu/MI300: throughput 12 tok/s, p95 400ms
- Mistral-8B eu/MI300: throughput 20 tok/s, p95 260ms

ada: Could be quantization + kernel interchange. q4_0 vs q4_mi differ in packing so kernel selector might mis-estimate memory. Try forcing quant=q4_mi or run with KERNEL_OVERRIDES to avoid the CPU fallback for a test. Also check GQA implementation flags. :thinking_face:

matt: Can you dump the kernel selector decision with KERNEL_DEBUG=1? Also try running the same mi300 job with --quant q4_mi and --kv_cache_shard=1 to see if it changes path.

priya: Running a quick variation now. Attaching the command I launched: 
```bash
KERNEL_DEBUG=1 ./bench_runner --model qwen-7b --region eu-west1 --gpu mi300 --ctx 65536 --batch 1 --quant q4_mi --kv_cache_shard=1 > /tmp/qwen_mi300_q4mi.log 2>&1 &
```

priya: Early result — kernel selector stayed on mi300_fast_attention_v2 when using q4_mi, p99 dropped to 420ms. Looks like quant packing influences selection.

luca: Good. That suggests selector mis-estimates memory for q4_0. We should: 1) tweak estimator for q4_0 on MI300; 2) add explicit guard to prefer fast kernels for Qwen longctx if estimated memory delta within X%.

hana: One more datapoint: Mistral shows stable behavior across both regions, likely because Mistral's GQA shape is simpler and KV memory scales linearly so selector is confident. Llama-2 has larger per-token compute so different tradeoffs.

ada: For capacity sizing — if Qwen on MI300 stays on fast kernel with q4_mi, we can expect ~22-24 tok/s per GPU for 64k longseq, so plan 4x capacity vs H100 for same QPS. If it falls back to CPU_hybrid_kernel, throughput collapses to single-digit tok/s so capacity needs jump and p99 spikes severely.

matt: Can someone open a short PR to: (a) log kernel_estimate inputs when a fallback happens, (b) add a heuristic to prefer fast kernel when model==qwen-7b and ctx>32k (temporary). Put it in eng-ml repo under kernels/selector.

priya: Will file the issue and PR today. Also scheduling a run to verify q4_mi quality difference — saw minor bleu drop on math tests at 64k but within tol. Posting eval summary once done.

deploy-bot: deployment started: kernel-estimator-hotfix v2026.3 -> staging (CI passed) :rocket:

matt: Nice — after the hotfix let's re-run the EU MI300 sweep with both quant modes and collect traces to confirm p99 improvement. Also include a run with continuous batching disabled to isolate it.

priya: Copy. I'll attach logs and the trimmed traces to the issue. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
